name: header_geometry
method: baseline = stored table + header-row inference; geometry = header rows rebuilt from pypdfium2 characters, filled boxes and rules, columns from Docling's body cell boxes (reglens/ingestion/header_geometry.py). Accuracy: value columns whose full header path equals the gold path (whitespace-insensitive).
adoption_rule: accuracy >= baseline + 10 points; 0 columns correct under the baseline become wrong on the tables labelled correct; on the 20 test tables no drop in cells found, number cells found or word coverage

adoption.decision: NOT adopted yet: the fixed rule passed on the labelled tables, but the out-of-sample spot check is 4 better / 3 worse / 3 mixed. Proposed fixes and a stricter rule (adding a fresh spot check) await approval.

note: second run, after the character-box bug fix of the first run (same method and parameters otherwise). The labelled tables were seen in the first run's output.
